title: Cech local-lift representative computes the connecting boundary
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let 0 \to A \to B \to C \to 0 be a short exact sequence of sheaves of O_X-modules, let U = {U_i} be an open covering of X, let s in H^0(X,C), and choose lifts t_i in B(U_i) of s|_{U_i}. Then the differences t_{i_1}|_{U_{i_0} cap U_{i_1}} - t_{i_0}|_{U_{i_0} cap U_{i_1}} are sections of A and form a Cech 1-cocycle; under the canonical homomorphism c_A from the first Cech cohomology group of U with values in A to H^1(X,A), its class maps to the connecting class partial(s) in the long exact cohomology sequence.

source.place: Cohomology, Lemma 0B8S (cohomology-lemma-cech-h1), local-lift description of the boundary; compatibility of the Cech-to-cohomology map with the connecting homomorphism

proof.text: Choose a monomorphism A \to I into an injective O_X-module by [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-modules-enough-injectives]. Injectivity extends this map across A \to B to a morphism phi:B \to I. With Q = coker(A \to I), the map B \to I induces psi:C \to Q and (id_A, phi, psi) is a morphism from 0 \to A \to B \to C \to 0 to 0 \to A \to I \to Q \to 0. Naturality of the connecting maps in the universal delta-functor [lem-weil-pbc-right-derived-universal-delta-functor] gives partial_B(s) = partial_I(psi(s)).

source.place: Lemma 015B (lemma-higher-derived-functors), naturality of the connecting morphisms; Cohomology of Schemes Lemma 09MS setup

proof.text: The sections phi(t_i) are local lifts of psi(s) in I. Since phi restricts to the chosen inclusion A \to I, their pairwise differences are the image in I of t_{i_1}-t_{i_0}; hence the A-valued Cech cocycle for the original sequence and the one for the injective sequence are the same under A \to I. This uses only restriction compatibility and subtraction of sections.

Apply the injective-middle comparison statement [lem-sc-boundary-cech-injective-middle] to 0 \to A \to I \to Q \to 0, q = psi(s), and the local lifts phi(t_i). It identifies c_A([t_{i_1}-t_{i_0}]) with partial_I(psi(s)). Step 1 identifies this class with partial_B(s), so c_A([t_{i_1}-t_{i_0}]) = partial_B(s), with the positive sign fixed by the differential convention in [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex].
